stem: What is the sum of all distinct real solutions to the equation \(|x^{2} - 2x - 8| = 7\)?
solution: The equation splits into two cases: \(x^{2} - 2x - 8 = 7\) or \(x^{2} - 2x - 8 = -7\).
All four solutions are distinct. Each quadratic has solutions summing to \(2\), so the total is \(2 + 2 = 4\).
verify:
x = symbols('x', real=True)
s1 = set(solve(Eq(x**2 - 2*x - 8, 7), x))
s2 = set(solve(Eq(x**2 - 2*x - 8, -7), x))
assert s1 == {5, -3} and len(s2) == 2 and not (s1 & s2)
assert all(simplify(abs(r**2 - 2*r - 8) - 7) == 0 for r in s1 | s2)
assert simplify(sum(s1 | s2)) == 4
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 4
